title: ShineDay Habit app is highly functional and so ADORABLE!! 🌈🌈🌈💕✨
body:
ShineDay Habit app is highly functional and so ADORABLE!! 🌈🌈🌈💕✨
This app is wonderful! I adore the minimal interface and the cute habit icons (I really appreciate apps that allow me to personalize things — especially the color of each habit! 💕). I am also very appreciative of the ability to create habit stacks, customization of “context” for each habit (ie: after rise, morning, afternoon) and to choose a check-off sound for habit completion. I initially had some anxiety that habits I am already working on (before downloading the app) wouldn’t be represented, so I was very delighted when I discovered I can add them as well and simply check off dates in the past 😌❤️!
Thank you for making this app!
author: *.M.M.*

title: Finally a simple Habit Tracker/Daily Planner
body:
I have downloaded like all of the habit trackers and daily planners. If you are looking for one that is simple, the cost is actually reasonable (even if you don’t pay you get the features you need to) & will keep track of your progress, this app is the one. 

The others are all way too over done and so much more expensive. I get very easily distracted and more importantly annoyed with apps that are doing things I didn’t ask it to trying to get my attention. This one does not. It notifies me if I ask it to for what I ask it to and lets me very simply keep track of what I am doing without having to jump through hoops of questions when I open the app. 

It’s wonderful, just what I was looking for. PLEASE never change what I am praising here. It is, in my opinion what makes it so wonderful! Simple is better.

body:

One thing i wish to point out is that I really wish I could add more habits in the free version. 
Normally, all habit tracker apps have only the option to add 3-4 habits free and I believe that is what limits the app from having even more users
This is because people who want to track even more habits uninstall the app looking for another one that does have the option to add more habits for free
I've experienced this myself (because as a student I have a tight budget) and I see that this app has so much potential! Being able to add more habits freely truly would make a difference between all the other habit tracker apps out there and would attract more users. :)

author: ss.samanthaaa

title: Amazing for people who forget to do things!!
body:
I just downloaded this app today and let me tell you, as someone who easily forgets to daily tasks or is trying to create a daily ritual, this app is FOR YOU! I am a person who finds great satisfaction of writing lists and also just “checking” or “crossing off” things so I love this app. While amazing, I do believe that there are places for improvement within the app and I hope that the company will pay attention to this review (I’m going pretty in-depth on stuff I believe will improve and allow more use of the app)

Things to Improve:
1. I find that while I can get by with the app, I do find limitations with some (part) of the app being in Chinese even when the English feature is turned on. If this is improved to be able to have pure English or pure Chinese, I believe more people will find this app AMAZING!! It’s a very well developed app with just some flaws which prevent some people from using it. 

2. I find that the app widget while convenient to use, the large widget (if I want to be able to “check” things off, is extremely large and takes up quite a bit of space on the screen 😭.) I feel like if you were to provide the middle sized widget as one that can also be used to “check” things off that would be amazing!! 

3. My next concern is that for every task I “check” off in the widget, the app opens up. I find this extremely tedious and makes the app less appealing to me. I would rather that for the widget, be able to “check” things off WITHOUT the app opening. 

4. This one might be my own personal preference, but I would love if you had a bottom section that was a calendar to show all daily tasks for a day, week or month!! (I hate how I have to click each daily task itself to see any sort of calendar 😪)  
Edit: I found in settings that you can put a timeline onto the bottom bar. (This should be implemented at first and you should give people the option to get rid of it not having it not there at first)

That’s pretty much all my concerns at the moment and I hope this can help and reach the creator to improve this already amazing app!

Google translate if it helps:

有待改進的地方：
 1.我發現雖然可以使用該應用程序，但我發現該應用程序的某些（部分）中文部分存在限制，即使打開了英語功能也是如此。 如果將其改進為可以使用純英語或純中文，我相信會有更多人會發現這個應用程序令人驚奇！ 這是一款非常完善的應用，僅存在一些缺陷，導致某些人無法使用它。

 2.我發現應用程序窗口小部件雖然易於使用，但是卻是大型窗口小部件（如果我希望能夠“檢查”某些東西，則非常大，並且會在屏幕quite上佔據相當大的空間）。 如果您要提供中型窗口小部件，並且還可以用來“檢查”某些東西，那就太好了！

 3.我的下一個擔心是，對於我在小部件中“選中”的每個任務，該應用程序都會打開。 我覺得這非常乏味，並且使該應用程序對我的吸引力下降。 我希望對於小部件而言，無需打開應用程序就可以“檢查”所有內容。

 4.這可能是我個人的喜好，但是如果您有一個底部作為日曆來顯示一天，一周或一個月的所有日常任務，我將不勝感激！  （我討厭必須單擊每個日常任務本身才能查看任何類型的日曆😪）
編輯：我發現在設置中您可以將時間軸放在底部欄中。  （這應該首先實現，您應該讓人們選擇擺脫它，而不是一開始就沒有它）

title: Cute, functional, & customizable
body:
This app super cute & quite customizable. It has nearly every feature I want on a habit tracking app (& I’ve tried most of them) - all for a very reasonable cost. A couple of requests would make it extra perfect:
1. The option to mark a habit as skipped
2. The ability to scroll or swipe through habits directly from the progress view (rather than returning to the habit list in order to select & re-open)
3. Following the above, the ability to select or filter habits in order to compare progress among specific items
4. Apple Watch app!
Thank you for this great app!!

title: The best habit tracker!!
body:
Such a lovely app. It has a simple, uncluttered interface, but has functionality in just the right places.
You can write mini journal entries each time you check off a habit, and see your monthly progress with each one.
This app is especially good if you want to establish a daily routine, since you have the option to set a few habits for morning, noon, and night. 
I also love how we have our choice in colors and cute icons for each habit :) but i would love to see a wider variety of icons for different activities! 
I look forward to using this app all summer and improving my life! thank you!!

title: Super Cute and Functional!
body:
Tip to get get everything to be in english:

1) click the three dots in the bottom
2) click on settings
3) language switch to english
4) instead of making your first habit through the typical way, do it through the gallery option (which is under the three dots towards the bottom of the options)
This somehow makes everything turn   english!
5) after that step, you can make more habits the regular way (aka doing it through add a new habit under the sun tab)
